name: Journal
description: The organization's double-entry journal (docs/journal.md): every paid order, refund, fee change, dispute the organization bears, marketplace sale and payout, promoter commission and cash movement at the door, posted as balanced entries in integer cents. Each row here is one line of an entry: exactly one of `debit_cents` / `credit_cents` is above zero, and the lines of one `entry_id` sum to zero. Entries are never edited or deleted: a change after the fact (a refund that fails, a re-priced marketplace order, a waived dispute recovery) is a further entry, and `reverses` names the entry a reversal undoes. Accounts: `stripe_clearing` (1000), `paypal_receivable` (1010), `pos_cash_drawer` (1020), `marketplace_receivable` (1100), `organizer_payable` (2000, owed to Exos), `sales_tax_payable` (2100), `promoter_commissions_payable` (2200), `gift_cards_outstanding` (2300), `tips_payable` (2400), `ticket_revenue` (4000), `buyer_fees` (4010), `pos_other_sales` (4020), `donations` (4030), `refunds` (4900), `exos_fee` (5000), `card_fees` (5010), `disputes` (5020), `promoter_commissions` (5030), `pos_paid_outs` (5040).

endpoints.description: The key's organization's journal lines, oldest entry first (then entry number, then line), paged. Filter by the entry's date (`from` inclusive, `to` exclusive), an event, an account or a source. Read-only.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Entries dated at or after this.

parameters.name: event_id
parameters.description: One event's entries. An event of another organization matches nothing.

parameters.name: account
parameters.description: One account's lines (a code from the list above).

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Where the entry came from: checkout_sessions, order_refunds, fee_adjustments, disputes, marketplace_orders, org_payout_lines, promoter_commissions, pos_payments, pos_paid_outs, pos_reversals (card refunds at the door), gift_card_ledger, gift_card_redemptions, pos_drawer_sessions, org_instant_payouts or paypal_org_remittances.

responses.description: A bad page, per_page, date, event id, account or source.

example.error: account must be one of stripe_clearing, paypal_receivable, pos_cash_drawer, bank, cash_on_hand, marketplace_receivable, organizer_payable, sales_tax_payable, promoter_commissions_payable, gift_cards_outstanding, tips_payable, opening_balances, ticket_revenue, buyer_fees, pos_other_sales, donations, gift_card_breakage, refunds, exos_fee, card_fees, disputes, promoter_commissions, pos_paid_outs, cash_over_short, gift_card_comps.
